chapter_title: Congratulation on the occasion of a birth and its reply

duas.dua_text_english: May Allah bless you with His gift to you, and may you (the new parent) give thanks, may the child reach the maturity of years, and may you be granted its righteousness.
duas.dua_text_transliteration: Bārakallāhu laka fi 'l-mawhūbi lak, wa shakarta 'l-wāhib, wa balagha ashuddah, wa ruziqta birrah.
duas.dua_text_arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ، وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ، وَبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ، وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ
duas.reference: An-Nawawi, Kitdbul-'Athkarp. 349, and Sahihul-'Athkar 2/713 by Saleem Al-Hilali
duas.occasion: Congratulating someone on the birth of a child

duas.dua_text_english: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and may Allah reward you well and bestow upon you its like and reward you abundantly
duas.dua_text_transliteration: Bārakallahu laka wa bāraka `alayk, wa jazākallāhu khayra, wa razaqakallāhu mithlah, wa ajzala thawābak.
duas.dua_text_arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً، وَرَزَقَكَ اللَّهُ مِثْلَهُ، وَأَجْزَلَ ثَوَابَكَ
duas.reference: An-Nawawi, Kitdbul-'Athkarp. 349, and Sahihul-'Athkar 2/713 by Saleem Al-Hilali
duas.occasion: Reply of the person being congratulated
